parameters.query:
SELECT 
  uws.day_routine_id,
  uws.user_id,
  uws.week,
  uws.session_name,
  users.full_phone_number,
  users.full_name
FROM user_weekly_schedule uws
JOIN users USING(user_id)
WHERE uws.planned_day = to_char((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND uws."Completed" = false
